job.title: Marketing Manager - Events & Communities
job.description:
The Role
This is not a typical marketing role, it's for a highly passionate leader who thrives on pace, energy and impact, and wants to be the driving force behind how a brand shows up in the room, not just on the page.
You'll own a busy national events calendar, spanning multiple well-known brands across the trade and consumer space, and become the single point of contact for how they come to life at every activation.

You'll be in the middle of it all: events, agencies, ambassadors, budgets and execution.

Why This Role Stands Out
  • A newly created role with real scope to shape how it grows
  • 30 to 40 major events a year across a network with huge reach
  • Genuine ownership of brand presence at events and activations
  • A new e-commerce platform build underway, with social playing a key role
  • Work with a broad portfolio of agencies, from stand builders to content specialists
  • Direct commercial impact, not just activity
This is a role centred around events and community leadership, not content admin.

About the Business

Its ASX-listed, with serious scale behind it and it has a large national footprint across both B2B and B2C channels. This is a business well recognised for setting the pace in its category, backed by a continued investment in resources. Currently doubling down on growth, there couldn't be a more opportune time to join.

What You'll Do
  • Own the major events calendar end to end: logistics, budgets, suppliers and on-the-day delivery
  • Act as the single point of contact for events, coordinating internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Manage a portfolio of external agencies, including a social-first agency handling day-to-day content
  • Own social media strategy and hold agencies and internal teams accountable for execution
  • Build and grow community engagement, working with brand ambassadors, influencers and sponsorship partners
  • Represent the brand at major industry events and conferences, bringing back fresh thinking on how the market is innovating
  • Support the rollout of a new e-commerce platform, with social playing a key role in the customer journey
What You Bring
  • A dedicated background in events, activations and project management (this is a specialist role, not a generalist marketing one)
  • A genuine, demonstrated understanding of social media as a strategic channel, with the confidence to brief and hold agencies accountable
  • Military-grade organisation: you anticipate what could go wrong and plan for it well before it happens
  • A natural people person who builds rapport fast and represents a brand well
  • Confidence working cross-functionally with agencies and multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Genuine energy for face-to-face engagement at events, including interstate travel
You move fast. You plan ahead of everyone else in the room. You make events happen; as you are always one step ahead.


If you're looking for a role where events, social and community actually matter, and you get to own how they show up, this could be one of your most career-defining moves.

APPLY now and your application will go directly to Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity.

job.title: Store Manager
job.description:
Your store. Your team. Built by you from day one.
  • Imagine loving where you work again...
  • Imagine being given the opportunity to build your own store from the ground up...
  • to recruit your own team...to shape the culture...to set the standards...to bring everyone together before opening day.
And then stand back as the doors open for the very first time and know you helped build it.

That's exactly what this opportunity offers.

Here's the exciting part... A brand-new large-format retail store is about to open in Grafton as part of the new Gateway Centre development — and we're looking for the Store Manager who will bring it to life.

With opening day only 6–8 weeks away, you'll join at exactly the right time.
This isn't a store you're inheriting.

It's yours to build.
  • Recruit and build your team from scratch. You'll play a key role in selecting the people who will stand beside you on opening day and help create the culture you want your store to be known for.
  • Lead a brand-new store opening. From pre-opening preparation and team onboarding through to launch and beyond, you'll have the opportunity to put your stamp on the operation from day one.
  • Be properly supported before you take the keys. You'll experience an excellent onboarding program, spending time across other stores and learning the business before stepping into your own.
  • Work for a retailer that genuinely invests in its people. You'll be trusted to make decisions, backed by experienced leaders and given every opportunity to build a long-term career.
  • Have some work-life balance. You'll work only one Saturday a fortnight, giving you every alternate weekend off.
  • Join a culture that's welcoming, down-to-earth and people focused. It's a business built around trust, teamwork, great customer experiences and celebrating success.
  • Be rewarded for what you bring. An attractive base salary, super, bonus and fully maintained vehicle reflect the importance of this leadership role.
This is a role for someone who loves retail, loves building teams and would relish the opportunity to create something from the ground up.

About you
You're already an accomplished Store Manager (or ASM ready to take a step up) from a medium or large-format retail environment, and you've built your reputation by getting the best out of both people and performance. 

You'll bring:
  • Experience leading a sizeable retail operation — a medium sized team, plenty of customers and lots of moving parts.
  • A strong track record of building great teams. You know what good looks like and how to bring different personalities together around a common goal.
  • A genuine feel for the numbers. You understand what's driving performance, where opportunities sit and what needs attention.
  • A knack for getting the best out of people. You set high expectations while creating an environment where people feel valued, supported and motivated.
  • Strong retail instincts. Stock availability, merchandising, inventory, wage control, shrinkage and customer service are second nature.
  • The confidence to make decisions and back yourself. You're comfortable taking ownership and creating structure when there isn't an established store routine to simply step into.
  • A leadership style people naturally follow. You're visible, approachable, decisive and never afraid to roll up your sleeves alongside your team.
  • Plenty of energy and ambition. You'll thrive on the buzz, challenge and excitement that comes with opening a new store.
If you've ever wanted the opportunity to build your own team, shape your own store culture and be there from the very beginning — this is it. For a confidential discussion, contact Gabby Symons on 0432 261 116 or gabbys@peopleequity.com.au, or simply apply now.

job.title: Store Manager
job.description:
Imagine loving where you work again...
  • Imagine walking into a store where your team genuinely enjoys coming to work…
  • Where you're trusted to lead…
  • Where you're encouraged to have fun…
  • Where your wins are celebrated...
  • And where your employer invests as much in your career as you invest in your people.
That's exactly what this opportunity offers.
  
Here's the exciting part...
  • Take the reigns of a high growth store - with remarkable year-on-year growth and an equally exciting future ahead.
  • Work for a retailer that invests in people, not just stores. You'll be trusted to make decisions, backed by experienced leaders and given every opportunity to build a long-term career.
  • Forget being thrown in the deep end. You'll experience one of the best onboarding programs in retail, spending time across multiple stores before officially taking the keys to your own.
  • Be in a role, which will also give you some work life balance. You'll only work one Saturday a fortnight, with every alternate weekend off.
  • Love coming to work again. The culture is welcoming, down-to-earth, customer obsessed and built around trust, teamwork and celebrating success.
  • Be rewarded for what you bring. An attractive base salary, super, bonus and fully maintained vehicle reflect the importance of this leadership role.
The opportunity
This isn't simply about running a successful store...it's about taking a store and its team from 'great to greater.'

You’ll:
  • Have full accountability for sales, profitability, customer experience, operational excellence and, most importantly, your people.
  • You’ll build an environment where your team feels supported, challenged and inspired to become the very best version of themselves.
  • You'll recruit exceptional talent, develop future leaders, drive commercial performance, identify new opportunities for growth and ensure every customer leaves wanting to come back.
This is a role for someone who loves retail, thrives in a fast-paced environment and gets genuine satisfaction from seeing both people and performance flourish.
    
About you
You're already an accomplished Store Manager from a either a medium or large-format retail environment, and you've built your reputation by growing both the business and the people around you.
  
You'll bring:
  • Experience running a serious retail operation—with a sizeable team within a sizeable store as well as lots of customers and plenty of moving parts.
  • A genuine feel for the numbers. You know what's driving performance, where the opportunities are hiding and when something needs attention before it becomes a problem.
  • The ability to turn strong results into even stronger ones. This store is already performing exceptionally well, so your challenge is to keep building momentum rather than simply maintaining it.
  • A knack for getting the best out of people. You know how to set high expectations, build capability and create a team that genuinely enjoys coming to work.
  • Strong retail instincts. Stock availability, merchandising, inventory, wage control, shrinkage and customer service are simply how you operate.
  • The confidence to make decisions and back yourself. You stay calm under pressure, lead change positively and know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.
  • A leadership style people naturally follow. You're visible, approachable, decisive and never afraid to roll up your sleeves alongside your team.
  • Plenty of energy and ambition. You love retail, enjoy winning, celebrate success and are always looking for ways to improve both your people and your business.  
If you're looking for more than just another Store Manager role— somewhere you can genuinely belong, make your mark and build a long-term career—we'd love to hear from you.
  
For a confidential discussion, contact Gabby Symons on 0432 261 116 or gabbys@peopleequity.com.au, or simply apply now.

job.title: GM - Business Development
job.description:
What's in it for you?

This is a refreshing opportunity...as you're not joining a start-up searching for scale...you're starting with it.

Part of a major Australasian group, this substantial organisation operates at the intersection of healthcare, retail, pharmacy, technology and consumer services. Think major national footprint, established brands and channels, significant customer reach, rich healthcare relationships, digital and data capability - and the investment capacity to turn great opportunities into something meaningful.

The core business is established, successful and is continuously growing. Now comes the exciting part: leveraging that platform to create what's next.
New services. New markets. New partnerships. New business models. New revenue streams.

Reporting directly to the CEO and joining the Executive Leadership Team, you'll have the mandate to look beyond the traditional core business, identify where the organisation should play next - and then make it happen.

The opportunity:

This is not a traditional strategy role. We're looking for a commercial growth leader and dealmaker - someone who can see an opportunity, determine its commercial viability, find the right partner and negotiate the deal over the line. You'll leverage the organisation's customers, channels, brands, data, digital capabilities and healthcare relationships to unlock entirely new avenues for growth.

More specifically, you'll:
  • Identify and build a pipeline of high-value growth opportunities and healthcare adjacencies.
  • Explore new markets, services, business models and revenue streams.
  • Originate, structure and negotiate significant strategic partnerships and commercial agreements.
  • Identify potential new ventures, investments and acquisition opportunities.
  • Find the right partners and get the right people around the table.
  • Work alongside specialist M&A, finance and legal teams to take opportunities from concept through to execution.
  • Turn great opportunities into revenue, earnings and enterprise value.
About you:
  • You're commercially curious, entrepreneurial and naturally external. You build networks, open doors and make things happen.
  • Just as importantly, you'll thrive in a culture that values people who are humble, hungry and smart - ambitious without the ego, commercially sharp, curious and naturally collaborative.
You'll bring:
  • Senior experience across strategic partnerships, business development, corporate development, new ventures and/or commercial growth.
  • A track record of personally originating and landing significant partnerships, ventures and/or deals.
  • Evidence of creating new revenue streams, entering new markets and/or developing new business models.
  • Strong commercial and financial judgement.
  • The credibility to influence and negotiate at CEO, Executive and Board level.
  • The ability to navigate a large organisation while maintaining an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Energy, curiosity and a genuine appetite to be out in the market, creating opportunities and getting deals over the line.
Experience across healthcare, pharmaceuticals, pharmacy, diagnostics, medical services or health technology will be highly regarded. However, exceptional commercial growth leaders from consumer, retail, technology or other sophisticated service environments will also be considered.

If this sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you (Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity) so please apply ASAP.

job.title: Product Development Manager
job.description:
Why This Role?
This high-growth, national organisation is already a clear leader in the electrical products space—built on a reputation for doing things differently. Rather than reselling other people's products, they design and own their private label ranges, solving real customer problems and raising the bar with every release. Now, they require an experienced Product Development Manager to take full ownership of their core product range, and its development end to end. 

The Opportunity
Reporting to the GM and supported by a Product Coordinator, you'll lead the private label Product Development function—with a clear focus on managing and continuously improving the core range. You'll work hands-on with manufacturers across China as well as engineers and technical specialists to turn ideas into commercially successful products then work internally to project manage them through to launch. This is a role where you won't design products yourself, rather you’ll own the process: concept, supplier collaboration, prototyping, compliance, manufacturing, launch and continuous improvement—start to finish.

What we are looking for
You get a buzz from solving problems, sweat the details, and take real pride in owning a process end to end—not just one piece of it. You also have:
  • Proven end-to-end Product Development experience, from concept to commercialisation.
  • Experience developing electrical related products where product testing, certification and regulatory compliance have been key.
  • Hands-on experience working with manufacturers across China.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
  • A commercially minded, hands-on approach and genuine curiosity.
Highly regarded experience includes:
  • Fire and life safety products
  • Industrial or engineered products
  • Consumer electronics, hardware or appliances
A qualification in Engineering, Product Design, Industrial Design, Manufacturing (or similar) will be highly regarded, however we're equally interested in experienced Product Development professionals who've built their expertise through hands-on industry experience.

Please apply ASAP or for any direct questions, please reach out to Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity at gabbys@peopleequity.com.au and 0432 261 116.

job.title: Head of Retail
job.description:
The Opportunity
Own the network. Elevate performance. Shape what’s next.
  • A significant senior leadership role with full ownership, clear accountability and scope to influence outcomes across a national ‘specialty’ retail network
  • Join a business where customers are highly engaged and deeply connected to the product category
  • Lead the evolution of a service-led retail model, where team capability and customer experience are key differentiators
  • Be empowered to lift capability, improve consistency and embed a high-performance, customer-first culture
  • Build on strong foundations, bringing greater structure, alignment and performance discipline to support the next phase of growth
Your role
  • End-to-end accountability for sales, margin, costs and overall network performance
  • Leadership of 4 Area Managers and capability across the store network
  • Development and execution of a clear retail strategy aligned to business objectives
  • Uplift of in-store execution, service standards and customer experience
  • Embedding teams as trusted advisors delivering tailored, needs-based solutions
  • Optimisation of systems, processes and operating rhythms to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Cross-functional alignment across marketing, product and supply chain
  • Driving performance improvement, store turnaround and network optimisation
  • Building a culture of accountability, ownership and continuous improvement
Your Leadership & Style
  • Leads through a layered leadership structure, empowering Area Managers to deliver results
  • Balances commercial discipline with a genuine commitment to customer experience and service quality
  • Builds teams that are engaged, knowledgeable and confident in delivering tailored solutions to customers
  • Creates clarity in environments that may lack structure, establishing disciplined yet practical ways of working
  • Drives performance while maintaining a strong focus on people, engagement and retention
 Is This You?
  • Proven experience operating at Head of Retail, GM Operations, National Operations Manager or equivalent level within a multi-site retail environment
  • Leadership of geographically dispersed store networks through a layer of senior leaders (e.g. Area/State Managers)
  • A background in specialty or service-led retail, where customer engagement, product knowledge and service quality drive performance
  • Demonstrated ownership of a meaningful P&L — with accountability for sales, margin, cost control and overall network profitability
  • A track record of lifting underperforming stores and scaling high-performing ones through clear operational levers
  • Experience building capability at scale — coaching leaders, developing succession pipelines, and embedding consistent ways of working across a network
  • Strong commercial instinct, with the ability to interpret data, identify opportunities, and translate insight into action at store level
  • Confidence operating in both structured and evolving environments, where you’ve improved systems, processes and operating rhythms
  • Exposure to cross-functional leadership, partnering with marketing, merchandise, supply chain or digital to drive aligned outcomes
  • High emotional intelligence, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and build credibility quickly across all levels of the business
If this sounds like you, apply ASAP, or for further queries, please contact
Gabby Symons – Managing Director, People Equity, gabbys@peopleequity.com.au, 0432 261 116

job.title: Category Manager
job.description:
What's in it for You?
  • Own a high-growth adventure category – shape the national strategy for 4x4, touring & roof racks across a major retail network.
  • Be the category voice – lead range, pricing and promotions in one of retail’s most passionate customer segments
  • Accelerate your career – a visible, commercial role in a role with broad exposure and genuine progression opportunities for performers
  • Build powerful partnerships – work directly with leading brands, the private label team and suppliers to secure innovation, exclusives & strong commercial term
  • Real rewards – competitive salary, flexibility, ongoing development and a workplace that values initiative and balance
  • South-East location & flexibility: Modern, open, collaborative offices designed for connection — with balance built in for how you work best.
Who you’ll be joining
You’ll be part of a large, well-established retail group known for offering customers high-quality automotive aftermarket, 4x4 and touring products across a broad national store network. This is a business experiencing significant transformation — investing in people, technology, data, private brand development, supplier partnerships and customer experience to take its merchandise category functions to the next level.
The culture is supportive, collaborative and commercially driven. You’ll join a Merchandise team that encourages fresh thinking, values commercially grounded ideas and empowers Category Managers to create retail offers that resonate with customers and deliver results.

What you’ll lead
As the Category Manager – 4x4, Touring & Roof Racks, you’ll take full ownership of a highly visible, fast-moving and enthusiast-driven category.

Your scope includes:
  • Range & assortment strategy – build compelling ranges across branded and private label products
  • Pricing & profitability – deliver competitive pricing while meeting sales, margin & growth targets
  • Promotional planning – manage supplier-funded activity, campaign selections & execution
  • Supplier partnerships – negotiate, secure commercial terms, strengthen relationships & identify innovations
  • Inventory & stock flow – manage DC inventory, exit plans, and stock-on-hand thresholds
  • Store engagement – share insights, communicate range decisions & support successful execution
  • Data-driven insights – use customer, sales & competitor data to refine strategy and identify new opportunities
  • Team capability – develop and mentor your Assistant Category Manager, supporting their progression
How you’ll make an impact
  • Build & deliver growth plans aligned to customer needs and commercial objectives
  • Manage pricing files, category performance and competitive reviews
  • Oversee promotional execution and measure campaign effectiveness
  • Lead supplier negotiations, rebates and long-term commercial agreements
  • Provide clear, insight-led recommendations based on market, customer and competitor analysis
  • Improve operational efficiencies across inventory, demand planning & DC processes
  • Partner closely with marketing to deliver strong customer-facing campaigns
  • Drive category innovation & push continuous improvement

What you’ll bring
  • Proven experience - in retail category management and buying – all backgrounds will be considered however those with category experience in hardgoods, outdoor, hardware, automotive and/or lifestyle products will be viewed favourably
  • Strong commercial judgement — pricing, margin, forecasting & financial acumen
  • Excellent negotiation & supplier relationship management skills - this is a given!
  • Analytical capability — you work confidently with data and insights
  • A customer-first mindset and an eye for product storytelling
  • A proactive, curious approach — prepared to challenge, refine and improve
  • Experience developing and coaching others is highly valued
If this sounds like you, APPLY now or if you have further questions, contact Gabby Symons at gabbys@peopleequity.com.au or 0432 261 116 for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Merchandise & Demand Planning Manager
job.description:
What’s in it for you?
  • Leave you’ll value: 4 weeks paid annual leave plus the ability to take up to 6 weeks total each year.
  • Parental leave: Up to 26 weeks paid for the primary carer and 8 weeks paid for the secondary carer (per policy).
  • Real ownership: A highly visible role, fully empowered to build the capability and strategy for merchandise and demand planning and inventory management.
  • A place that’s fun and celebrates wins: Unique talents are leveraged, and success is recognised.
  • Serious career runway: Ongoing growth creates limitless opportunities for top performers.
  • People-centric culture: Work where values truly guide decisions
  • Learn from the best: Collaborate with highly regarded mentors and leaders.
  • South-East location & flexibility: Modern, open, collaborative offices designed for connection on in-office days.
Your prospective employer:
This is a retail group that does things differently. With a large national store network and a strong reputation for delivering exceptional customer experience, they continue to grab market share year on year — not by standing still, but by innovating and investing in their people, their systems, and their stores. You’ll be joining a business that is future-focused: embracing technology, driving supply chain transformation, and elevating its merchandise and demand planning function to be best-in-class. The culture is one where collaboration and performance go hand in hand — where team members are encouraged to challenge the norm, contribute ideas, and be part of the company’s ongoing evolution. You will be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in retail, with leaders who value empowerment, trust, and delivering results as a collective. 

Your role:
As the Merchandise & Demand Planning Manager, you’ll be the architect of the planning strategy — taking full ownership of how the merchandise and demand planning is structured, executed, and optimised across the store network. This is a senior, influential position reporting directly to the GM Merchandise, with visibility across the entire retail business. Working to your strengths, you will lead a significant inventory portfolio , driving decisions that directly influence sales performance, margin growth, and customer satisfaction. Your remit spans end-to-end planning, from forecasting and inventory management to pricing and promotional accuracy.

Specifically, you will:
  • Set the direction: Build the merchandise and demand planning strategy, ensuring the right stock, at the right time, in the right place.
  • Leverage data and insights: Use sales trends, market data, and further develop the forecasting tools to make purchasing decisions that drive profitability.
  • Lead, coach, and inspire: Mentor and develop your direct and indirect team of Merchandise Planners, Demand Planners, and Allocators, building capability and succession strength.
  • Shape best practice: Introduce new forecasting methodologies, improve ERP processes, and create streamlined reporting to support smarter decisions.
  • Drive performance: Deliver sales, margin, and inventory targets that positively impact category and store results.
  • Collaborate widely: Partner with Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, and Merchandise teams — as well as vendors and suppliers — to align stock levels and promotional activity.
  • Be the change leader: Champion a culture of continuous improvement, guiding your team through transformation and capability uplift.
This is not just about “maintaining” a function — it’s about building and elavating it. You’ll be the driver of innovation, the connector between functions, and the voice that ensures the merchandise and demand planning is a strategic enabler of growth.

What it will take
  • Proven depth: Senior leadership experience across merchandise/demand planning, forecasting and inventory management in retail, where you have had end-to-end ownership of the planning function.
  • Strategic + hands-on: Are just as comfortable setting the vision and strategy and rolling up your sleeves in the day-to-day.
  • Commercial rigour: Exceptionally strong with numbers; integrate clear analysis and business rationale into decisions.
  • People leadership: A natural leader who has built, coached and scaled sizeable teams; trusted, influential and outcome-focused.
  • Project & stakeholder excellence: Strong program delivery, stakeholder management and the ability to influence at all levels.
  • Mindset: Astute, innovative and action-oriented; you spot opportunities and move decisively.
  • Communication & integrity: You build trust, collaborate effectively and drive execution.
  • Category-agnostic: Impactful leadership and planning depth matter more than specific category experience.
A career here is more than a job — it’s your chance to grow, thrive, and make a meaningful impact. If this sounds like you, APPLY now or contact Gabby Symons at gabbys@peopleequity.com.au or 0432 261 116 for a confidential conversation.

job.title: National Operations Manager - Industrial, Automotive & Trade
job.description:
What’s in this for you?
  • A brilliant newly created fully empowered role - championing change & driving outcomes for greater Branch operational efficiencies and capitalisation of market opportunities
  • Join at one of the most exciting times and in a role that will scale: harness the opportunity to shape and refine the Branch/B2B operational strategy, challenge the status quo and develop the network for further growth, and expansion across the Automotive & Industrial market sectors
  • Be handsomely rewardedwith a package including generous base, car component and bonus
  • The ability to take 6 weeks leave a year (4 paid)
  • Further career possibilities are limitless for performers, due to the size, nature and ongoing growth of the business
  • A workplace that lives, operates and stands by its ‘people centric’ values. It’s a great place to work!
  • Parental Leave:If a baby is on the horizon…the offer of 26 weeks paid leave for the primary carer and 8 weeks for the secondary carer
  • The offices are in the South East: It’s flexible, open and collaborative, set up to leverage the sharing and expertise that everyone brings for the days when you are in the office
The Company:
Be part of something ‘AWESOME.’ Backed by strategic growth, investment and an unstoppable commitment to its people and customers, this large automotive aftermarket player sets the pace across its extensive Trade, Wholesale and Retail channels. With success vested in brand strength, market differentiation, service, and its people, it’s no surprise they keep going from ‘strength to strength.’ With ‘opportunity knocking’ within one of their key Wholesale/Trade businesses, a new role has been created with full operational accountability and for developing and executing the strategic change and growth plans for their Branch Network, which will maximise current business strengths and explore new growth avenues. There seriously couldn’t be a more exciting time to join.

The role
As the National Operations Manager – Automotive, Trade & Industrial
you will ensure the Branch network achieves its growth and development objectives whilst also enhancing customer experiences and setting a foundation for future growth and success in the Automotive & Industrial market segments. More specifically you will:
  • Lead and manage the Branch network and develop the sales and Branch operations teams. A core focus will be on optimising the operating formula, increasing share within the industrial market and replicating this formula for new Branch openings as the business expands its network further
  • Establish key performance measures, targets and activity plans in accordance with the organisations business plans, while ensuring the plans have the flexibility to adapt to market opportunities and ongoing changes in conditions and segments
  • Drive national brand marketing strategies, increasing market awareness and driving share of customer wallet
  • Be mentoring, developing and coaching your Branch Managers and building a team culture that focuses on delivering customer service excellence at every touchpoint.
You 
  • You have the right experience: You have likely held a Head of/National Operations/Multi site role in a B2B organisation that has a Branch network, where you have been fully accountable for the Branch networks P&L.  
  • You have led transformational change, and driven key  business/customer outcomes resulting in greater operational efficiencies and outcomes for a Branch network.
  • You have an understanding of the industrial marketplace, as well as exposure to the automotive aftermarket category (or similar). This will ensure you can ‘hit the ground running.’
  • You are proven: in your ability to articulate a clear vision and play a hands-on role in creating a strategy (i.e. the “how”) for the Branch Network/B2B operations, driving transformation and implementing new ways of working
  • You have the full set of technical skills: surrounding financial management and literacy, sales and marketing, stakeholder engagement, strategy and planning, people management and operational excellence. A leadership style and interpersonal approach that places people at the forefront will be key
  • Your stakeholder and relationships management skills are ‘next level.’ You can influence, deliver and drive sustainable profitable outcomes at the highest of levels and you are proven in driving and leading change and developing strategies, with people and partners, always on the journey
